== Description ==
'''UI-246''' is the 11th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-246''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

It will appear in the center of the room, rushing back after 4- seconds it will rush back, rebounding back to the main room a few times, it will depsawn at the door.

== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide immediately when you hear/See him, and stay hidden untill it despawns

== Trivia ==
* it sounds like a bass boosted UI-5.
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-246''' was added as a joke.
